🗣Eisenkot says ‘creative and extraordinary political moves’ needed to form new Israeli government
🔴No one will be able to keep every promise they made,🔴 said Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar! party, who was given a mandate to form the new Israeli government by President Isaac Herzog.
Eisenkot, who insists that forming a “national emergency government” takes priority, has received Herzog’s approval after securing recommendations of 67 Knesset members, with his rival Benjamin Netanyahu only managing to garner 46 recommendations.
«A stable government is needed; now is the time to reach out a hand,» Herzog himself has remarked, as quoted by Israel’s Channel 13.
Eisenkot is now expected to meet with the Yisrael Beiteinu party leader Avigdor Lieberman to discuss the new government’s formation.
